Ask Dr. Mortgage

Your questions and privacy

The answer tool searches Dennis’s guides. It is not a live conversation with Dennis, a loan application, an approval, or a rate quote.

What is saved

The interface is hosted on DR. Mortgage USA. Questions are processed by the same guide-backed answer service used by the original Ask Dr. Mortgage tool. Questions, answers, article links, feedback and article clicks are stored by that service to improve the library. This release does not send your questions to an external AI answer service.

Please do not enter names, account numbers, Social Security numbers or documents. Common email addresses, phone numbers and account-number patterns are removed before questions are stored. This automatic filter cannot identify every private detail.

Returning to a conversation

A secure browser cookie gives this browser access to its conversation for seven days. Someone using the same browser may see that conversation. The cookie is not an advertising tracker.

Deleting and keeping records

Use “Delete conversation” in the question panel to remove the current conversation, its feedback and associated activity from the live answer-service database. Starting a new conversation does not delete earlier records. The delete control works while this browser still has access.

Raw questions and activity have a 90-day retention period. Expired records are removed when the answer service next processes a question or opens the research desk. Editorial briefs, reviewed wording and anonymous topic summaries may be kept separately to maintain the blog; deleting a conversation does not remove those editorial materials.

Dennis’s research and wording tools require owner access. Owner testing is separated from visitor traffic in research reports.

For a privacy question, use the Call Dennis link in the site header. See the DR. Mortgage USA privacy policy for the main website.
